candidates.statement: VI. Performance Testing Recommendations 198 Pursuant to section 502(f) of the FD&C Act and 21 CFR 801.5, a device must have labeling that 199 bears adequate directions for use, meaning directions under which the layman can use a device 200 safely and for the purposes for which it is intended. Due to the nature and duration of contact of 201 menstrual products, in order for the device to be used safely when used as intended, we 202 recommend the performance testing discussed in this section to evaluate the safety of the 203 materials and performance characteristics of the device. Such testing will help to inform what is 204 needed to ensure, among other things, the adequacy of the directions for use included in the 205 labeling. Such recommended performance testing, and documentation of such testing, will also 206 help to ensure compliance with the QSR (21 CFR Part 820) and record requirements to the extent 207 required under applicable law, including in the QSR (e.g., 21 CFR 820.30(j)). Notably, QSR 208 records and other records required under the FD&C Act must generally be made available to an 209 FDA investigator upon request (see section 704(e) of the FD&C Act). 210
